name.value: Okanagan Lake Provincial Park, North Campground

description.value: A summer-season provincial park campground set among ponderosa pine and sagebrush directly on Okanagan Lake, with pebbly beach access, swim areas, and panoramic lake and mountain views; the gate is locked off-season and rattlesnakes inhabit the dry hillsides above camp.

raw_osm.name: Okanagan Lake Provincial Park, North Campground

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Okanagan Lake Park is an active provincial frontcountry campground 11km north of Summerland with two large campgrounds on Okanagan Lake; the OSM record specifically identifies the North Campground with a capacity of 80. The BC Parks frontcountry camping page and the park's own 'Book camping' link confirm reservations are accepted. The website mentions a summer concession at the south campground gatehouse (connected to the north by a 1km trail), supporting a food-nearby value; no mention of showers, potable water, device charging, or other specific amenities was found.
concerns: OSM phone number (+1-250-548-0076) appears to belong to operator Kaloya Contracting Ltd. rather than BC Parks directly; not confirmed on the BC Parks website.
No civic address in OSM; park is described as 11km north of Summerland on Hwy 97 but no street address is available.
Concession food source is at the south campground, not the north; cyclists would need to use the 1km connecting trail to access it.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established 80-site BC Parks provincial campground on Okanagan Lake; a natural stop for cyclists touring the South Okanagan corridor on Hwy 97.
